description: Complete study-generated numerical records and reproducible code for the PMC-VQA crop-ranking study. This version preserves S2-S12 and adds S13: four-cyclic-order probability averaging for primary Qwen3-VL 2B, all 128 excluded technical pilot and 2048 main questions, and answer-position/runner-up diagnostics. It includes the prior derangement, smaller-window and calibration extensions. Original single-order primary contrast: -0.15 pp (95% CI -0.81 to 0.52). Four-order matched contrast: +0.98 pp (nominal 95% CI +0.26 to +1.71). Averaged baseline and guided direct accuracy were both 45.80%; the original near-zero contrast is conditional on order handling. All extensions are exploratory; no external preregistration, clinician label audit or larger-model experiment is claimed. Source images, question/option text and model weights are not redistributed. Study-generated data, documentation and figures are CC BY 4.0; study-authored code is MIT. Original third-party rights are retained. OpenAI Codex assisted code development, execution, numerical verification, documentation and plotting.
